title: Avoid display-object allocation per frame
why: Allocating display objects every frame creates avoidable garbage and GPU/resource churn.
suggestion: Create and attach display objects outside the ticker callback, then mutate or pool them per frame.
limitations: PixiJS v8 migration checks require an explicit version 8 pixi.js or @pixi dependency in package.json.
Ticker ownership is resolved only for direct receiver.ticker.add/remove calls and inline frame callbacks.
